title: Word registry (src/data/lexicon/word-registry.json)
description: Audio and Living Dictionary links of every Benga word form, keyed by word key. Written by `npm run words:sync`, `words:import` and /admin/palabras, and sometimes by hand. Guide: docs/WORD-REGISTRY.md

propertyNames.description: The word key (src/utils/audioId.js): lower-case letters, digits, '_' around accented letters, '-' between words.

livingDictionaryId.description: Id at the end of the entry URL …/benga/entry/<id>, or null.

audioFile.description: Cloudinary file name without .mp3, only when it differs from the key.
